create.name: Ally Bogard
create.bio:
Ally Bogard is a yoga and meditation teacher, mentor and author who has spent more than twenty years leading group processes, workshops and teacher trainings. Her teaching sits where somatic practice meets contemplative practice: she works through the body, at an unhurried pace, to help students stay present and honest with whatever their lives are asking of them, and she is interested less in technique than in becoming, as she puts it, a practitioner of life.

Her book The Quiet Teachers: Becoming a Student of Your Life is a collection of short reflections, each paired with a practice, on finding guidance in ordinary encounters, sensations and relationships. She runs a small yearly mentorship group with live sessions, one-to-one time and a theme of inquiry each semester, and short online series such as Integrate, which mixes yoga, somatic work, silence and open questions over four Sundays. Her longer recorded teachings are shared through a newsletter, and her classes also appear on online yoga platforms. Alongside this she co-founded The Twenty Six, which guides families through the emotional side of passing on wealth.

books.title: The Quiet Teachers: Becoming a Student of Your Life
books.author: Ally Bogard
books.description: Short, stand-alone reflections on noticing the guidance hidden in daily life, from bodily sensations and beliefs to the people we meet. Each one ends with a practice or a question for reflection.

courses.title: INTEGRATE: Practice Series
courses.description: Four live online Sunday sessions combining yoga, somatic practice, silence and open questions with Ally, focused on living out insights already gained. All sessions are recorded.

courses.title: Mentorship 2027
courses.description: A small group that meets for eight live sessions around a theme of inquiry set each semester, with teaching, guided practice, dialogue and one-to-one time. The winter theme and dates are still to be announced.
